title: Asana connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [Asana connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/asana) is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

Use the connector to ingest work management data such as workspaces, teams, projects, tasks, portfolios, and goals from Asana into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth user-to-machine (U2M) authentication.
